title: Stalnaker's logical problem of conditionals is unsolvable
summary: The logical problem of conditionals, as conceived by Stalnaker, amounts to axiomatizing a particular semantics for conditionals which utilizes selection functions that take propositions (i.e., sets of worlds) as arguments. While the sentential form of this semantics is recursively axiomatizable, we prove that its enrichment with first-order quantifiers is not---that is, we show that Stalnaker's logical problem of conditionals is unsolvable in the language with first-order quantifiers.
